series.title: The Borrowed Light
series.readerPromise: A repairer learns that restoring a city means changing who controls its resources.
series.centralConflict: A guild controls every legal repair core.
series.endgame: The districts govern repair resources together, after paying real costs.

canon.rule: Repair moves usable strength; it cannot create matter or free energy.

volumes.title: A District of Borrowed Light
volumes.dramaticQuestion: Can the repairer keep her district alive without handing its last cores to the guild?
volumes.climax: She chooses a public, costly repair rather than a private escape.

chapterCards.purpose: Expose the false safety report and make the repair cost personal.

scenes.goal: Seal the gate before the lower street floods.
scenes.obstacle: The official report says the gate is sound, but the braces are crumbling.
scenes.turningPoint: The only compatible donor material is her own transport cart.
scenes.choice: Dismantle the cart despite losing her livelihood.
scenes.consequence: The street survives, but she must ask a former rival for transport.
scenes.emotionalChange: Competence is no longer enough; she must accept help.
scenes.nextSceneBecause: The lost cart forces the meeting that reveals the missing-core ledger.
mustNotRevealYet: The identity of the signal's sender.

establishedMemory.explanation: This example contains plans, not written chapters. Established facts remain empty until supported by accepted manuscript text. Future records must cite stable chapter IDs, exact quotations and current source hashes.
